decisions.reason: As a newly launched sensor module with its own product page and clear fit to the firm's modular measurement platform, we would tolerate early uncertainty and keep it unless results quickly fell well below aspiration.

Because it is an explicit next-generation replacement for an existing voltage-measurement module, it sits in a proven product line and is likely to meet aspiration relative to its predecessor, so we keep it.

The MQTT proxy strengthens the software side of the platform at relatively low carrying cost, so boundedly rational management would keep it while learning about adoption rather than redeploy resources immediately.

A CAN bus interface matches German industrial and embedded customer needs and complements the core hardware ecosystem, so despite somewhat less visible promotion we would keep it while monitoring whether performance reaches aspiration.

The CO2 sensor module is strategically consistent with the firm's sensing portfolio, and with dedicated launch visibility we would keep it during the early evaluation period unless overlap or weak demand created a clear aspiration shortfall.

The touch panel accessory is more peripheral than the core sensing and interface modules, but as a platform-complementary add-on with uncertain early demand we would still keep it for now because available slack justifies further observation.
